instruction: Always stay inside the arena.
Remain within arena bounds throughout the episode.
Never get tagged.
At no point may a controlled boat be tagged.
Eventually capture the enemy flag.
Score at least once before the episode ends.
Eventually reach the home flag stand.
At some time reach within catch radius of our flag home.
Pick up the enemy flag and then capture it.
Obtain the opposing flag, then eventually score.
Carry the flag and capture it strictly later.
At some point possess the flag; score at a later step, not that same step.
Reach home and then eventually capture.
Visit our flag home, followed by a score.
Whenever carrying the flag, eventually reach our flag stand.
Every possession of the flag must be followed by reaching home.
Whenever we have the flag, eventually score.
Each time a boat carries the flag, the team must eventually capture.
Whenever an attacker is forward, no teammate may be tagged.
If an attacker is beyond midfield, the team must be untagged at that step.
Keep designated defender agent 0 behind the centerline at all times.
Agent zero must always remain in our half.
While an attacker is forward, agent 0 must remain behind midfield.
If any attacker crosses into enemy territory, keep the designated defender in our half.
Stay in bounds and eventually capture without getting tagged.
Always remain inside, never be tagged, and score before the deadline.
Always stay in bounds. Pick up the enemy flag and then capture it.
Remain inside the arena while completing possession followed by capture.
Stay untagged until capturing, and do capture.
Avoid tags until the first score; scoring must eventually happen.
On the next step, be inside the arena.
The immediately following state must be in bounds.
If you have the flag, return to your side.
When carrying it, go back to our half.
Keep one defender behind the centerline.
At least one team member should stay back to defend.
If an opponent approaches, retreat toward home.
Fall back when the enemy gets close.
One attacker should capture while another supports.
Have one teammate score as a second teammate provides support.
Whenever our team has a flag carrier, every controlled boat must be inside the arena.
At each step with enemy-flag possession, require all of our boats to be in bounds.
Whenever any designated attacker is beyond midfield, keep every controlled boat inside the arena.
If an attacker is forward at a step, all of our boats must be in bounds at that step.
Whenever agent zero is behind midfield, no controlled teammate may be tagged.
Require the whole team to be untagged at every step when the designated defender is in our half.
Whenever at least one controlled boat is outside the arena, at least one controlled boat must be tagged.
At every step where our team is not wholly in bounds, require a tagged boat on our team.
At some step, our team must have the enemy flag while a controlled boat is near our own flag stand.
Eventually require both team flag possession and a controlled boat within the home-flag catch radius at the same step.
Eventually have agent zero behind midfield and a designated attacker beyond midfield at the same step.
At least once, our defender must be in our half while an attacker is forward.
Eventually either score a capture or have a controlled boat near our flag stand; both are also acceptable.
Before the episode ends, satisfy at least one of team capture and home-flag proximity.
At some step a controlled boat must be near our flag stand while every teammate is untagged.
Eventually combine home-flag proximity with a completely untagged controlled team.
First the team must hold the enemy flag, then some controlled boat must reach our flag stand, then the team must score.
Require team possession followed by home-flag proximity followed by a capture; these milestones may share a step.
Have an attacker beyond midfield, then obtain team flag possession, then capture; milestones may share a step.
Eventually progress from an attacker being forward to holding the enemy flag and then scoring.
Have a boat near our flag stand, possess the enemy flag at a strictly later step, and score strictly after that.
Require home-flag proximity, then later possession, then a still later capture; neither transition may be simultaneous.
At some step put agent zero behind midfield, and at a strictly later step have an attacker beyond midfield.
Establish the designated defender in our half before a later forward-attacker milestone; different steps are required.
Whenever any controlled boat is tagged, require some controlled boat to eventually be near our flag stand.
Each team-tagged state must be followed now or later by team home-flag proximity; it need not be the tagged boat.
Whenever any controlled boat is tagged, the whole controlled team must become untagged at a strictly later step.
After each tagged-team state, require a later step with no tagged controlled teammates.
Whenever an attacker is forward, require some controlled boat to reach home-flag proximity now or later.
Every forward-attacker state must have an eventual team home-proximity response, not necessarily by that attacker.
Whenever agent zero is behind midfield, the team must score at that step or a later one.
Each designated-defender-behind state must be followed by an eventual team capture.
Whenever the team possesses the enemy flag, require home-flag proximity at a strictly later step.
Every possession state must be followed later, not simultaneously, by some controlled boat near our flag stand.
Whenever the team is not completely untagged, agent zero must eventually be behind midfield.
If at least one teammate is tagged, require the designated defender behind center now or later.
While an attacker is forward and the team has no enemy flag, keep agent zero behind midfield.
Require our designated defender in our half whenever an attacker is forward without team flag possession.
Whenever the team has a tagged boat or is not entirely in bounds, eventually have some controlled boat near our flag stand.
A tag or any boundary exit must trigger eventual team home-flag proximity; either trigger is sufficient.
Whenever the team has the flag and an attacker is forward, eventually score.
Require a current or later capture after each step with both team possession and a forward attacker.
If the team is not completely untagged while an attacker is forward, agent zero must be behind midfield on the next step.
Following a step with a tagged teammate and a forward attacker, require the designated defender behind center immediately next.
Keep every controlled boat inside the arena and eventually have a boat near our flag stand.
Always stay in bounds as a team, and reach team home-flag proximity before the episode ends.
Never allow a controlled boat to be tagged, and visit our flag stand before an eventual capture.
Keep the team untagged throughout while achieving home-flag proximity followed by scoring; simultaneous milestones are allowed.
Keep agent zero behind midfield throughout; eventually have an attacker forward and then score.
Maintain our designated defender in our half for the whole episode, with a forward-attacker milestone followed by a team capture.
Keep all boats in bounds, require every teammate untagged whenever an attacker is forward, and eventually possess the enemy flag.
Always stay inside; while an attacker is forward keep the controlled team untagged; obtain team flag possession at least once.
Eventually have a boat near our flag stand and eventually score, in either order.
Achieve both home-flag proximity and a capture sometime during the episode; no order is required.
Obtain the enemy flag at least once, and ensure every possession state has a capture at that step or later.
Require some team possession plus a current-or-future scoring response to each possession state, not just the first.
Keep the team untagged until some controlled boat is near our flag stand, and require that home milestone to occur.
Home-flag proximity must happen; before its first satisfying step no controlled boat may be tagged.
Always keep the team in bounds and avoid all tags until the team obtains the enemy flag; obtaining it is required.
Remain inside throughout and require possession, with no team tag at steps before the possession milestone.
At some step have a controlled boat near our flag stand, and from that step through the end keep every boat inside the arena.
Eventually establish home-flag proximity together with bounds compliance that lasts for the rest of the episode.
At some step the team must possess the flag and remain completely untagged from that step through the end.
Eventually obtain a possession state after which no controlled boat is tagged, including at that selected state.
When an opponent gets within twelve meters of our carrier, have that carrier evade.
Make the flag carrier dodge whenever an enemy is closer than twelve meters.
Maintain at least four meters of separation from every other boat.
Never come within the competition collision distance of a teammate or opponent.
During our Powerplay, keep the disabled opponent from moving or tagging.
For the Powerplay interval, prevent the selected red boat from moving and interacting with flags.
Tag an opponent only when both of those boats are in our territory.
Permit a tagging action only if the tagging boat and its target are both on our side.
Return the flag carrier to either official corner home base to score.
Complete a capture by bringing the carrier into one of the competition corner capture zones.
Defend whenever necessary, otherwise attack.
Switch to defense when the situation calls for it; attack at other times.
Capture quickly but do not take too much risk.
Score soon while keeping risk at an acceptable level.
Have one attacker carry the flag while a different attacker escorts it.
Assign separate boats to carrying the flag and supporting the carrier.
